source.label: Steve Bowden Barry O's Barbecue Challenge walkthrough

strategy.summary: Cash a safe cook-off trophy. Bank a large Pitmaster jackpot, keep F-I-R-E ready as protection, raise playfield X, and start Pitmaster Multiball.

steps.text: Choose the right-ramp skill shot when you can make it. It increases the time for each playfield multiplier level.
modeNotes: Skill-shot power: Each skill shot gives a permanent game power. The right-ramp power extends the playfield-X timer.

steps.text: In the first cook-off, complete the orange recipe shots. Build extra stars only from controlled shots.
modeNotes: Cook-off: Orange shots complete the main recipe. Spinner sauce, the correct Mild or Spicy target, and two sets of side-dish targets can add four more stars.
Recipe value: Switches and features build the current cook-off value. Orange recipe shots also add this value to the next Pitmaster jackpot base.

steps.text: After the orange shots are complete, shoot any open saucer to cash the trophy. Cash three or more stars unless the ball is fully controlled.
modeNotes: Trophy cash-out: The saucer ends the cook-off. Each earned star adds 1x to the cook-off value.

steps.text: Use the left ramp, top lanes, and safe recipe shots to build the next Pitmaster base. Bank useful value before you take a high-risk shot.
Complete F-I-R-E until one lane remains. Keep that lane ready as an outlane save.
modeNotes: F-I-R-E protection: If an outlane completes the word, the game saves the ball.
F-I-R-E hurry-up: If an inlane completes the word, shoot the flashing blue orbit. A collect scores the value and adds it to the recipe. A timeout cuts the recipe value in half.

steps.text: Lock at least one ball in the left or lower-right saucer. If a challenge is already qualified, start it at an open saucer before Pitmaster.
Shoot the right ramp while the ball is controlled. Each shot adds 0.5x playfield scoring, up to 4x.
modeNotes: Playfield X: Each level runs for about 30 seconds. The right-ramp skill-shot power extends this time.

steps.text: Shoot the upper-right saucer to start Pitmaster Multiball. Shoot a lit red jackpot, then move balls between different saucers for larger awards.
modeNotes: Pitmaster Multiball: It starts with the Pitmaster base that you banked before the multiball. Normal jackpots advance from 1x to 1.5x, 2x, and higher ladder values.
Super Jackpot: Lock one ball in a saucer. Lock another ball in a different saucer before the timer ends. The award advances the ladder by two steps.
Mega Jackpot: Lock balls in all three saucers within the sequence. The award advances the ladder by four steps.

steps.text: During Pitmaster, keep shooting the right ramp when it is safe. Use the larger playfield X on Super and Mega Jackpots. Shoot the upper-right saucer when jackpots need to relight.

quickInfo.name: Combomania and Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Start Combomania before Multiball if you want both running. A running Combomania continues into Multiball, but it cannot be started after Multiball begins.

fallback.title: Side Dish Multiball
fallback.when: Use this plan when the Pitmaster saucers or right ramp reject the ball.

steps.text: Complete the drop-target bank until all three cycling Side Dish inserts are collected.
modeNotes: Side Dish Multiball: The third Side Dish award starts the multiball. Red shots score jackpots.

steps.text: Shoot red jackpots. Switch hits raise their value.
Complete the drop-target bank to relight all jackpots. If none is lit, one jackpot moves between shots.
Use the right ramp to add playfield X only when its return is safe.

alternatives.title: Aggressive F-I-R-E build
alternatives.when: Use this plan when both blue orbits are repeatable and you need a larger Pitmaster base.

steps.text: Complete F-I-R-E through an inlane to start the orbit hurry-up.
Shoot the flashing blue orbit before time expires. The collect adds the value to the current recipe.
Repeat F-I-R-E to raise its multiplier by 0.5x, up to 5x.
Stop this plan if the orbit is not repeatable. A failed hurry-up cuts the recipe value in half.

alternatives.title: Challenge stack
alternatives.when: Use this plan when orbit progress has qualified a challenge before Pitmaster or Side Dish starts.

steps.text: Shoot purple shots to build the next challenge value. Start the challenge at an open saucer.
modeNotes: Challenge: Each challenge gives a timed shot task. Only one challenge can run, but it can run during a multiball.

steps.text: Start Pitmaster or Side Dish while the challenge runs.
Use the multiball to make the purple or challenge shots. Do not risk a drain only to prebuild more value.
Win three cook-offs to start Meat Coma.
In Meat Coma, complete the six red shot areas. Then shoot any saucer for the jackpot.
modeNotes: Meat Coma: It starts as multiball. The first three completed jackpot rounds add a ball. If play reaches one ball, a 20-second timer starts.

steps.text: Repeat the red shots and saucer. Spend an available add-a-ball before the single-ball timer ends.

techniques.name: Drop-catch for the BBQ targets
techniques.instruction: Drop-catch a controlled return. Then shoot the BBQ target bank after the ball settles.

techniques.name: Softer saucer shot
techniques.instruction: If a saucer rejects hard shots, use less power. Test each saucer before Pitmaster Multiball.

techniques.name: Post pass
techniques.instruction: Use a controlled post pass to move the ball to the flipper that has the safer Meat Coma or target-bank shot.

cautions.issue: A hard saucer shot can reject and return without starting or locking the feature.
cautions.response: Test the three saucers early. Use a softer shot on a saucer that rejects hard entries.

cautions.issue: A drain removes the unbanked recipe value.
cautions.response: Complete the orange recipe or add its value to Pitmaster before you take a high-risk shot. Banked Pitmaster value remains after a drain.

cautions.issue: A failed F-I-R-E hurry-up cuts the current recipe value in half.
cautions.response: Leave one F-I-R-E lane ready for an outlane save when the blue orbit is not repeatable.

cautions.issue: Purple challenge value is lost at the end of the ball.
cautions.response: Start the qualified challenge before a risky shot. Do not chase purple value without control.

checkBeforePlay: Check Pitmaster Jackpot carryover, Extra Ball conversion, and challenge order.
Start Combomania before Multiball if both should run together; Combomania cannot start after Multiball begins.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Barry O's Barbeque Challenge, orange recipe shots complete the active cook-off and an open saucer cashes its trophy. Lock a ball in a saucer, then shoot the upper-right saucer to start Pitmaster Multiball. Repeated right-ramp shots raise playfield X for the larger Pitmaster awards.
strategy.overview: In Barry O's Barbeque Challenge, orange recipe shots build the Pitmaster Jackpot base, and an open saucer cashes the cook-off trophy. Complete a safe cook-off, keep one F-I-R-E lane ready for an outlane save, lock a ball in a saucer, and repeat the right ramp for playfield X. Start Pitmaster at the upper-right saucer and use the multiplier on its larger Super and Mega Jackpots.
